headlines.title: WDAY's Operating Margin Expands: Will the Improvement Continue?
headlines.summary: Workday's operating margin jumped as subscription growth and AI adoption strengthened profitability, but sustaining the gains remains key.

headlines.title: From SaaS-pocalypse to Perfect Storm: Workday’s AI Growth Story Strengthens
headlines.summary: Workday's Q2 revenue grew 12.8% and margins widened as AI adoption accelerated, with $1.33 billion in buybacks and a new $4 billion authorization fueling a bullish, if capped, outlook.

headlines.title: How AI-Driven Subscription Gains and New Buyback Plan May Shape Workday (WDAY) Investors
headlines.summary: Workday, Inc. reported past second‑quarter fiscal 2027 results with revenue rising to US$2,649 million and net income to US$632 million, alongside sharply higher earnings per share compared with a year earlier. The company highlighted strong uptake of its AI-powered offerings, raised full-year subscription and margin guidance, and approved a new open‑ended US$4.00 billion share repurchase plan after completing a prior US$4.00 billion buyback.

headlines.title: Workday (WDAY) Says AI Drove 25% of New Annual Contract Value. Why Did Total Subscription Backlog Grow Only 8%?
headlines.summary: Workday, Inc. (NASDAQ:WDAY) is beginning to show that artificial intelligence can generate measurable contract activity. Second-quarter subscription revenue increased 13.9% to $2.471 billion, while AI products produced more than $100 million of new annual contract value, or ACV. description: Workday, Inc. provides enterprise cloud applications in the United States and internationally. The company offers a suite of financial management applications to maintain accounting information; manage financial processes, such as payables and receivables; identify real-time financial, operational, and management insights; perform financial consolidation; reduce time-to-close; promote internal control and auditability; and achieve consistency across finance operations. It also provides spend management solutions that help organizations to streamline supplier selection and contract management, build and execute sourcing events, such as requests for proposals, and manage indirect spend; expense management solutions to submit and approve expenses; and a suite of human capital management applications that enables HR teams to hire, onboard, pay, develop, reskill, and provide employee experiences. In addition, the company offers planning applications. Further, it provides supply chain and inventory solutions to healthcare organizations; solutions to manage the end-to-end student and faculty lifecycle; Workday Extend for customers and their developers to build custom applications. The company serves the professional and business services, financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, media, education, government, technology, media, retail, and hospitality industries. It sells its solutions through its direct sales organization. The company was formerly known as North Tahoe Power Tools, Inc. and changed its name to Workday, Inc. in July 2005. Workday, Inc. was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Pleasanton, California.
